# Cleanora AI

    > Cleanora is a Windows-only desktop app that classifies filenames and metadata locally. Users can review exact destinations before applying moves. Verified supported systems: Windows 10, Windows 11.

## Core pages

- [Local File Organizer for Windows](https://cleanora-ai.github.io/ai-file-organizer/): Organize Windows folders with local metadata-based classification, exact destination previews, explicit confirmation, audit history, and conflict-safe undo.
- [Best File Organizer for Windows](https://cleanora-ai.github.io/best-file-organizer-windows/): Compare AI, rule-based, and manual file organization for Windows. See which approach fits Downloads cleanup, renaming, privacy, and large folders.
- [How to Clean Your Downloads Folder Automatically](https://cleanora-ai.github.io/clean-downloads-folder/): Clean and organize a crowded Windows Downloads folder with a repeatable workflow for documents, installers, archives, images, and temporary files.
- [How to Organize Files Automatically on Windows](https://cleanora-ai.github.io/organize-files-windows/): Build a practical Windows file system for Downloads, Desktop, Documents, and project folders, then automate repeated sorting and renaming.
- [File Organizer for Windows](https://cleanora-ai.github.io/windows-file-organizer/): Organize Downloads, Desktop, Documents, and project folders on Windows with local planning, preview-first review, and reversible changes.
- [Organize Files Automatically Without Losing Control](https://cleanora-ai.github.io/organize-files-automatically/): A safe workflow for categorizing, renaming, and archiving thousands of files with previews, small batches, and a structure built for retrieval.
- [Preview File Moves Before Organizing Windows Folders](https://cleanora-ai.github.io/preview-file-moves-windows/): Preview exact file destinations, conflicts, categories, and reasons on Windows before confirming a bulk organization plan with Cleanora.
- [File Organization for Students](https://cleanora-ai.github.io/use-cases/students/): Organize course readings, lecture slides, assignments, notes, and screenshots with a semester system that remains easy to archive.
- [File Organization for Freelancers](https://cleanora-ai.github.io/use-cases/freelancers/): Organize briefs, contracts, invoices, source files, deliverables, and feedback with a repeatable client folder lifecycle.
- [File Organization for Researchers](https://cleanora-ai.github.io/use-cases/researchers/): Organize literature, protocols, data, analysis, figures, manuscripts, and administrative records without replacing specialist research tools.
- [File Organization for Accountants](https://cleanora-ai.github.io/use-cases/accountants/): Organize client records, invoices, statements, tax documents, workpapers, and exports with year, entity, status, and retention controls.
- [Cleanora vs Cloud AI File Organizers](https://cleanora-ai.github.io/alternatives/cloud-organizers/): Compare local Windows file organization with cloud-based AI organizers by privacy, preview control, setup, and offline use.
- [Cleanora vs File Juggler](https://cleanora-ai.github.io/alternatives/file-juggler/): Compare Cleanora's metadata-based suggestions with File Juggler's Windows rules for moving, renaming, deleting, and document-based workflows.
- [Cleanora vs Microsoft Power Automate](https://cleanora-ai.github.io/alternatives/power-automate/): Compare a focused local file organizer with Microsoft's broader workflow automation platform for desktop, cloud, and business processes.
- [Automatic vs Manual File Organization](https://cleanora-ai.github.io/alternatives/manual-organization/): Compare automatic and manual file organization by setup time, review, control, scale, consistency, and the types of files each method handles best.
